integrity: The algebraic component proof and orbit classification are stated with their hypotheses. Exhaustive tests over two finite fields check but do not prove the all-field theorem. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Reduced representation variety only, in matrix dimension two and characteristic two. Prior work already determines the labeled point count and the absolutely simple module sector; neither is claimed as a new independent result. Same-object specialized priority risk remains for sources not available in full.
title: A non-equidimensional characteristic-two Jordan-plane representation variety and its rational orbits
